surprises.title: Dryer starts smoking
surprises.description: Oh no! The old dryer is smoking. Not metaphorically.

options.text: Keep running it with the door open
Unplug it and start the replacement
Gut the laundry room and start over

surprises.title: Scorch marks behind it
surprises.description: Behind the dryer, the wall is brown, warm, and weirdly proud of itself.

options.text: Cover it with a framed poster
Replace the scorched drywall
Rebuild the whole laundry room wall

surprises.title: Outlet has melted
surprises.description: The dryer plug has fused to the outlet. It's modern art now.

options.text: Pry it out with a screwdriver
Have an electrician swap outlet and cord
Rewire the whole house

surprises.title: Lint everywhere
surprises.description: Behind the dryer: a lint ecosystem with its own weather.

options.text: Blow it into the next room
Vacuum it up and clean out the vent
Hire a duct cleaner for the whole house

surprises.title: Vent hose is crushed
surprises.description: The foil vent hose is folded flat like a sad accordion. No wonder it smoked.

options.text: Straighten it and tape it
Replace it with rigid metal duct
Replace all the ductwork in the house

surprises.title: Wall needs to open
surprises.description: The vent disappears into the wall, packed solid. Somebody has to look.

options.text: Poke a coat hanger in and hope
Cut a small access hole
Take the whole wall down

surprises.title: Beehive in the wall
surprises.description: A low hum. Then a very large honeycomb, and its very concerned owners.

options.text: Spray it and keep cutting
Call a beekeeper to remove the colony
Fumigate the whole house

surprises.title: Honey in the wall
surprises.description: Behind the hive: years of honey in the drywall. It's sticky. It's everywhere.

options.text: Paint right over it
Cut out the damp section and replace it
Gut the whole wall and rebuild

surprises.title: Drywall dust everywhere
surprises.description: Opening the wall made a snowstorm. It's in the vents, the couch, and the dog.

options.text: Sweep it into the next room
Seal it off and HEPA vacuum
Pay for a whole-house deep clean

surprises.title: Plug doesn't match
surprises.description: Four-prong cord, three-prong outlet. The adapter says 'not recommended' in four languages.

options.text: Run it off an extension cord
Install the matching four-prong outlet
Swap in a three-prong cord

surprises.title: New dryer won't fit
surprises.description: The new dryer is two inches wider than the alcove. Of course it is.

options.text: Knock out the wall studs
Return it for one that fits
Rebuild the laundry alcove bigger

surprises.title: Floor is dented
surprises.description: Sliding out the old dryer took a chunk of the floor with it.

options.text: Slide a rug over it
Patch the damaged section
Replace the flooring in the whole room

surprises.title: The cat is in the vent
surprises.description: From deep inside the duct, a very small, very smug meow.

options.text: Run the dryer to coax him out
Cut an opening and gently rescue the cat
Replace the whole duct system

surprises.title: Vent cap is clogged
surprises.description: Outside, the vent flap is stuffed with a bird's nest. The bird is not leaving.

options.text: Poke it clear with a stick and walk away
Clean it and replace the vent cap
Reroute the vent through the roof

surprises.title: Stackable dreams
surprises.description: The alcove is tall. A stacked washer and dryer would free up so much floor.

options.text: Balance the dryer on top of the washer
Put it on the next project's list
Rebuild the alcove tonight for stacking

surprises.title: Smart dryer sale
surprises.description: The store has a dryer that texts you when it's done. It also has opinions.

options.text: Keep the smoking one, it's basically fine
Buy the basic model as planned
Buy the smart one, subscription and all

surprises.title: Partner requests a shelf
surprises.description: Your partner: "While the dryer's out, that shelf above it is crooked."

options.text: Leave the machine in pieces and fix it now
Fix it once the dryer is hooked up
Build a laundry room with custom cabinets

video.title: Dryer vent cleaning, step by step

ask.question: How do I fix my dryer vent?
ask.answer: Here's a quick guide! 1. Pull the dryer out. 2. Clean the lint. 3. Push it back!
ask.skipped: It skipped unplugging it and replacing the foil hose.
